t: John Feizy, founder of Feizy Rugs, dies at 83 - Furniture Today
s: July 16, 2025 - John Hosein Feizy was born in Arak, Iran, in 1942 and emigrated to the U.S. in 1963. He attended Central State University (now University of Central Oklahoma) in Edmond, Oklahoma, working multiple jobs to pay his tuition and earning a business degree. He founded Feizy Rugs in 1973, following a family tradition of buying, selling and collecting rugs that spanned four generations.
